claim_boundary: A checked channel means that at least one documented search pass was completed. It does not mean every relevant source in that region or channel has been found.
completion_rule: Discovery can only become saturated after every area has documented searches across official agency, disciplinary repository, program archive and publication-linked channels, followed by two consecutive rounds with no new high-relevance source.
